about: PERMAFLEET cross-org squadrons, shown at /operations/PERMAFLEET/squadrons as the path to membership, with a page each at /operations/PERMAFLEET/squadrons/<id> (unit paths from contracts/roles.dot). `tier` is `entry` (one squadron application covers all of them; leadership selects) or `elite` (earned by performance, never applied for). `next` is the id of the squadron the best go on to. `role`, `body`, `entry`, and `leadsTo` are trusted HTML.

squadrons.name: BRAVO SQUADRON
squadrons.body: Fighter pilots from every member org who fly security for PERMAFLEET. Official training runs on Friday Night Fights.

squadrons.name: TURTLE BRIGADE
squadrons.body: PERMAFLEET’s infantry, starting with basic infantry training.

squadrons.name: ALPHA SQUADRON
squadrons.role: Elite fighters · run by G00N SQUAD
squadrons.body: The tip of the spear for PERMAFLEET: the top 5% of BRAVO SQUADRON, selected on performance.

squadrons.name: SHELLBACK
squadrons.body: PERMAFLEET’s elite infantry unit, selected from the best of TURTLE BRIGADE.
